retained_revenue.explanation: Version 1's approval was invalidated, but no capture has been verified yet, so no difference can be stated.

shots.name: 01_storefront_home
shots.caption: The storefront home. Every price on it was read from the Commerce API during this page load.

shots.name: 02_category_dairy
shots.caption: Dairy & Eggs, priced by the merchant at catalogue revision 28.

shots.name: 03_razorai_panel
shots.caption: RazorAI answers a Hinglish request and shows the tool calls it actually made. It holds no capability to approve or to pay.

shots.name: 04_basket_quote
shots.caption: The basket and the merchant's quote. The rice crosses the free-delivery threshold, so the fee and its tax are gone — merchant policy, not a discount an agent invented.

shots.name: 05_approval_card_v1
shots.caption: Version 1's approval card. The buyer approves a hash and an integer amount, not a sentence.

shots.name: 06_the_refusal
shots.caption: The kernel refuses the stale approval. HTTP 200 carrying a decision, the exact delta, version 1 retired and version 2 offered.

shots.name: 07_payment_handoff
shots.caption: The payment handoff. The API never called Razorpay; the durable worker did, holding a single-use grant it had already spent.

shots.name: 08_orders_no_capture_yet
shots.caption: The orders page, empty and saying so. It renders what the API returned rather than inventing a row.

shots.name: 09_console_retained_revenue
shots.caption: The merchant's side of the same refusal: four committed rows, and the platform declining to state a difference until a capture is verified.

shots.name: 09b_console_proof_chain
shots.caption: The Money Action Proof Chain, link by link: the hash recomputed, the receipt bound to the version, the grant consumed once, and every provider mutation accounted for.

shots.name: 10_console_operations_orders
shots.caption: Operations, orders tab. Counts come from the API, and an empty result says it is empty rather than failing quietly.

shots.name: 11_console_operations_refunds
shots.caption: Refunds, split by state: pending, unknown and failed are three different facts.

shots.name: 12_console_operations_outbox
shots.caption: The durable outbox. Every Razorpay call this platform has ever made left a row here first.

shots.name: 13_console_operations_safe_mode
shots.caption: The kill switch, asked of the kernel rather than inferred. Refunds are never swept by it.

shots.name: 14_console_inspector
shots.caption: The whole of payment attempt 01a06fba…, as one document.

not_captured.reason: No order exists on this tenant. A capture needs a card entered on Razorpay's own hosted page, which an unattended run cannot do. Re-run with --pay and complete the test payment to capture this shot.
